question: Rekap omset per tim sales untuk pelanggan wilayah APAC.
sql: SELECT r.team, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND c.attributes['region'] = 'APAC' GROUP BY r.team ORDER BY total_omset DESC

question: Tim sales mana yang total pipeline-nya paling besar di pelanggan Mid-Market?

question: Bandingkan win rate tiap tim sales untuk pelanggan tier Gold.

question: Per tim sales, berapa deal won yang wilayah pelanggannya sama dengan wilayah sales dan yang berbeda?

question: Bandingkan omset deal lintas wilayah vs satu wilayah (wilayah pelanggan vs wilayah sales) per segmen.
sql: SELECT c.segment, sumIf(d.value, c.attributes['region'] = r.region) AS omset_wilayah_sama, sumIf(d.value, c.attributes['region'] != r.region) AS omset_wilayah_beda FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY c.segment

question: Per wilayah sales, rasio deal won yang pelanggannya satu wilayah dengan sales-nya terhadap seluruh deal won.

question: brp deal pipeline yg customernya beda wilayah dgn salesnya, per tim sales

question: Per tim sales, bandingkan win rate pada pelanggan satu wilayah dan pada pelanggan beda wilayah.
sql: SELECT r.team, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won' AND c.attributes['region'] = r.region) / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost') AND c.attributes['region'] = r.region), 2) AS win_rate_sama, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won' AND c.attributes['region'] != r.region) / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost') AND c.attributes['region'] != r.region), 2) AS win_rate_beda FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.team ORDER BY r.team

question: Rata-rata nilai deal won untuk kasus wilayah sama dan wilayah berbeda antara pelanggan dan sales, per segmen.
sql: SELECT c.segment, round(avgIf(d.value, c.attributes['region'] = r.region), 2) AS rata_wilayah_sama, round(avgIf(d.value, c.attributes['region'] != r.region), 2) AS rata_wilayah_beda FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY c.segment

question: Per tim sales, jumlah aktivitas ke pelanggan satu wilayah vs beda wilayah.

question: Sales mana yang lebih dari 50 persen deal won-nya berasal dari pelanggan beda wilayah? Tampilkan rasionya.

question: Tampilkan per wilayah pelanggan jumlah meeting oleh sales satu wilayah dan oleh sales beda wilayah.

question: Per tipe aktivitas, rata-rata durasi pada pelanggan satu wilayah dengan sales dibanding beda wilayah.

question: total pipeline lintas wilayah (cust beda region sama sales) vs satu wilayah, per tim

question: Per bulan tahun ini, jumlah deal won satu wilayah dan lintas wilayah antara pelanggan dan sales.

question: Tampilkan jumlah pelanggan unik yang ditangani sales beda wilayah dan yang satu wilayah, per segmen.

question: Per segmen, win rate di wilayah sama vs wilayah berbeda (customer vs sales)

question: Per tim, bandingkan jumlah email yg dikirim ke pelanggan dgn wilayah sama dan beda dari sales-nya

question: Per wilayah pelanggan, nilai forecast dari sales satu wilayah dan dari sales beda wilayah.

question: Per sales, tampilkan daftar pelanggan unik (nama) yang punya deal won tahun ini.

question: Pelanggan yang dihubungi lebih dari 5 sales berbeda, sertakan jumlah sales-nya.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, uniqExact(r.rep_id) AS jumlah_sales FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING jumlah_sales > 5 ORDER BY jumlah_sales DESC

question: Per tim sales, list nama sales unik yang punya deal negotiation.

question: Pelanggan dengan deal dari lebih dari 2 tim sales berbeda; tampilkan jumlah tim dan daftar timnya.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, uniqExact(r.team) AS jumlah_tim, groupUniqArray(r.team) AS daftar_tim FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING jumlah_tim > 2 ORDER BY jumlah_tim DESC

question: Sales mana yang punya lebih dari 30 pelanggan unik lewat deal? Sertakan jumlahnya.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, uniqExact(d.customer_id) AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING jumlah_pelanggan > 30 ORDER BY jumlah_pelanggan DESC

question: Per segmen pelanggan, tampilkan jumlah sales unik dan daftar tim sales yang pernah deal won di segmen itu.
sql: SELECT c.segment, uniqExact(r.rep_id) AS jumlah_sales, groupUniqArray(r.team) AS daftar_tim FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY jumlah_sales DESC

question: list 10 pelanggan dgn total omset terbesar plus daftar nama sales yg closing-nya
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, groupUniqArray(r.name) AS daftar_sales, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY total_omset DESC LIMIT 10

question: Sales yang pernah menangani pelanggan dari 4 wilayah pelanggan berbeda; tampilkan jumlah wilayah dan daftarnya.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, uniqExact(c.attributes['region']) AS jumlah_wilayah, groupUniqArray(c.attributes['region']) AS daftar_wilayah FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING jumlah_wilayah = 4 ORDER BY r.rep_id

question: Per wilayah sales, berapa pelanggan unik dan berapa tipe aktivitas berbeda yang tercatat?
sql: SELECT r.region, uniqExact(a.customer_id) AS jumlah_pelanggan, uniqExact(a.type) AS jumlah_tipe FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.region ORDER BY jumlah_pelanggan DESC

question: Pelanggan yang punya tiket urgent dan dihubungi lebih dari 3 sales berbeda, tampilkan jumlah sales dan jumlah tiket urgent-nya.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, k.jumlah_tiket, s.jumlah_sales FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT t.customer_id AS customer_id, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent' GROUP BY t.customer_id) AS k ON c.customer_id = k.customer_id INNER JOIN (SELECT a.customer_id AS customer_id, uniqExact(a.rep_id) AS jumlah_sales FROM activities AS a GROUP BY a.customer_id HAVING jumlah_sales > 3) AS s ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id ORDER BY k.jumlah_tiket DESC

question: Tim sales dengan jumlah pelanggan unik (lewat aktivitas) terbanyak, tampilkan hanya yang di atas 500.
sql: SELECT r.team, uniqExact(a.customer_id) AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.team HAVING jumlah_pelanggan > 500 ORDER BY jumlah_pelanggan DESC

question: per sales, daftar produk unik yg dijual di deal won (pakai nama sales)
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name AS rep_name, groupUniqArray(produk) AS daftar_produk FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS produk WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY r.rep_id

question: Pelanggan Enterprise dengan lebih dari 2 deal pipeline, tampilkan jumlah deal, total pipeline, dan daftar nama sales-nya.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, count() AS jumlah_deal, sum(d.value) AS total_pipeline, groupUniqArray(r.name) AS daftar_sales FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') AND c.segment = 'Enterprise' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING jumlah_deal > 2 ORDER BY total_pipeline DESC

question: Berapa perusahaan unik per tim sales yang punya deal won?
sql: SELECT r.team, uniqExact(c.company) AS jumlah_perusahaan FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.team ORDER BY jumlah_perusahaan DESC

question: Sales dengan rata-rata nilai deal won di atas rata-rata seluruh deal won, sertakan rata-rata dan jumlah pelanggan uniknya.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, round(avg(d.value), 2) AS rata_nilai_deal, uniqExact(d.customer_id) AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING avg(d.value) > (SELECT avg(d2.value) FROM deals AS d2 FINAL WHERE d2.stage = 'won') ORDER BY rata_nilai_deal DESC

question: Pelanggan bertag high-value yang dihubungi lebih dari 2 tim sales berbeda, sertakan jumlah tim.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, uniqExact(r.team) AS jumlah_tim FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE has(c.tags, 'high-value') GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING jumlah_tim > 2 ORDER BY jumlah_tim DESC

question: Per tim sales, tampilkan daftar wilayah pelanggan unik yang mereka layani dan jumlah pelanggan unik per tim.
sql: SELECT r.team, groupUniqArray(c.attributes['region']) AS daftar_wilayah_pelanggan, uniqExact(c.customer_id) AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id GROUP BY r.team ORDER BY jumlah_pelanggan DESC

question: sales mana yg dealnya melibatkan paling banyak produk berbeda? top 3
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, uniqExact(produk) AS jumlah_produk FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id ARRAY JOIN d.products_involved AS produk GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY jumlah_produk DESC LIMIT 3

question: Pelanggan yang punya lebih dari 1 sales berbeda pada deal won dan nilai omset total di atas 1 juta, tampilkan jumlah sales, omset, dan nama sales-nya.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, uniqExact(r.rep_id) AS jumlah_sales, sum(d.value) AS total_omset, groupUniqArray(r.name) AS daftar_sales FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING jumlah_sales > 1 AND total_omset > 1000000 ORDER BY total_omset DESC

question: Per segmen dan tim sales, jumlah pelanggan unik yang punya tiket open.
sql: SELECT c.segment, p.team, uniqExact(c.customer_id) AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN support_tickets AS t FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT d.customer_id AS customer_id, r.team AS team FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id) AS p ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id WHERE t.status = 'open' GROUP BY c.segment, p.team ORDER BY c.segment, jumlah_pelanggan DESC

question: Sales yang menangani pelanggan dengan tiket urgent terbuka; tampilkan jumlah pelanggan unik dan daftar nama pelanggannya.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, uniqExact(c.customer_id) AS jumlah_pelanggan, groupUniqArray(c.name) AS daftar_pelanggan FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT t.customer_id FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent' AND t.status IN ('open','in_progress')) GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY jumlah_pelanggan DESC

question: Tampilkan perusahaan yang punya deal dengan lebih dari 3 sales berbeda beserta jumlahnya.

question: ada berapa sales unik per tim yg pernah meeting dgn pelanggan SMB?
sql: SELECT r.team, uniqExact(r.rep_id) AS jumlah_sales FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE a.type = 'meeting' AND c.segment = 'SMB' GROUP BY r.team ORDER BY jumlah_sales DESC

question: Per wilayah pelanggan, tampilkan nama tim sales yang terlibat dan jumlah deal won-nya, hanya wilayah dengan lebih dari 200 deal won.
sql: SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS wilayah_pelanggan, groupUniqArray(r.team) AS daftar_tim, count() AS jumlah_won FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY wilayah_pelanggan HAVING jumlah_won > 200 ORDER BY jumlah_won DESC

question: Sales dengan jumlah pelanggan unik berstatus churned terbanyak lewat deal; tampilkan 5 teratas.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, uniqExact(c.customer_id) AS jumlah_churned FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE c.status = 'churned' GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY jumlah_churned DESC LIMIT 5

question: Tim sales mana yang punya omset tertinggi dari pelanggan tier Bronze tahun lalu?
sql: SELECT r.team, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND c.attributes['tier'] = 'Bronze' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(subtractYears(today(), 1)) AND d.closed_date < toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY r.team ORDER BY total_omset DESC LIMIT 1

question: tampilkan sales wilayah NA beserta tim-nya yg pernah meeting dgn pelanggan churned

question: Total deal won per wilayah pelanggan dari tim Account-Management, hanya wilayah dengan omset di atas 5 juta.

question: Pelanggan Mid-Market yang pernah dipegang tim Inbound dan tim Outbound-Enterprise sekaligus, tampilkan id dan nama.

question: Sebutkan nama sales dan nama pelanggan untuk deal won yang ditutup kemarin.

question: rata2 waktu resolusi tiket per wilayah pelanggan utk customer yg punya deal sama sales tim Inbound

question: Per tim sales, omset tahun ini dari pelanggan yang punya tiket urgent maupun yang tidak, dalam dua kolom.

question: Siapa sales yang punya deal negotiation dengan pelanggan churned? Sertakan jumlah deal-nya.

question: Berapa tiket urgent dari pelanggan Enterprise yang dipegang sales wilayah APAC (lewat deal)?

question: Tim sales mana yang rasio deal lost-nya (terhadap deal won+lost) paling tinggi di pelanggan Gold? Tampilkan tim dan rasionya.

question: cari customer yg punya deal pipeline tapi sales-nya beda wilayah dgn customer, tampilkan nama customer & nama sales

question: Jumlah aktivitas demo dan meeting per tim sales untuk pelanggan yang punya deal negotiation.

question: Pelanggan dengan tiket urgent terbuka lebih dari 1 yang punya deal pipeline; tampilkan jumlah tiket, total pipeline, dan nama sales-nya.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, k.jumlah_tiket, o.total_pipeline, o.daftar_sales FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT t.customer_id AS customer_id, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.priority = 'urgent' AND t.status IN ('open','in_progress') GROUP BY t.customer_id HAVING jumlah_tiket > 1) AS k ON c.customer_id = k.customer_id INNER JOIN (SELECT d.customer_id AS customer_id, sum(d.value) AS total_pipeline, groupUniqArray(r.name) AS daftar_sales FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') GROUP BY d.customer_id) AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id ORDER BY o.total_pipeline DESC

question: Berapa jumlah deal won per wilayah sales untuk pelanggan tier Silver?

question: Tampilkan sales yang menangani pelanggan bertag retail dengan deal won, beserta total omsetnya, 5 teratas.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND has(c.tags, 'retail') GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name ORDER BY total_omset DESC LIMIT 5

question: Per tim sales, rasio pelanggan unik dengan deal pipeline yang juga punya tiket terbuka.

question: list pelanggan manufacturing yg dipegang sales wilayah LATAM lewat deal, tampilkan nama sales juga

question: Total durasi aktivitas (menit) per tim sales dan per tipe aktivitas untuk pelanggan wilayah NA.

question: Rata-rata jumlah tiket per pelanggan, per tim sales (pelanggan lewat deal).

question: Tampilkan jumlah customer per segmen yang punya deal dgn tim Account-Management.

question: 5 deal won terbesar dari pelanggan Enterprise beserta nama customer dan nama sales yang memegangnya.

question: Per wilayah pelanggan, tampilkan tim sales dengan omset terbesar saja.
sql: SELECT x.wilayah_pelanggan, x.team, x.total_omset FROM (SELECT c.attributes['region'] AS wilayah_pelanggan, r.team AS team, sum(d.value) AS total_omset, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.attributes['region'] ORDER BY sum(d.value) DESC) AS urutan FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' GROUP BY wilayah_pelanggan, team) AS x WHERE x.urutan = 1 ORDER BY x.wilayah_pelanggan

question: Sales yang aktivitas negatifnya (sentimen negative) ke pelanggan Enterprise lebih dari 60, tampilkan jumlahnya.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, count() AS jumlah_negatif FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE a.sentiment = 'negative' AND c.segment = 'Enterprise' GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING jumlah_negatif > 60 ORDER BY jumlah_negatif DESC

question: customer aktif yg punya tiket resolved dan dipegang sales Inbound, id + nama aja
sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.name FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE r.team = 'Inbound') AS p ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id INNER JOIN support_tickets AS t FINAL ON t.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.status = 'active' AND t.status = 'resolved'

question: Tampilkan per tim sales: total pipeline, total omset, dan jumlah pelanggan unik, hanya dari pelanggan tier Gold.
sql: SELECT r.team, sumIf(d.value, d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')) AS total_pipeline, sumIf(d.value, d.stage = 'won') AS total_omset, uniqExact(c.customer_id) AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE c.attributes['tier'] = 'Gold' GROUP BY r.team ORDER BY total_omset DESC

question: Jumlah tiket per prioritas dari pelanggan yang punya deal won dengan sales wilayah EMEA.
sql: SELECT t.priority, count() AS jumlah_tiket FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT d.customer_id FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND r.region = 'EMEA') AS p ON t.customer_id = p.customer_id GROUP BY t.priority ORDER BY jumlah_tiket DESC

question: pelanggan prospect atau lead yg sudah punya deal pipeline, sertakan nama sales & tim
sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, r.name AS rep_name, r.team FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE c.status IN ('lead','prospect') AND d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')

question: Sales dengan win rate di atas 0.5 pada pelanggan Enterprise, tampilkan win rate dan jumlah deal selesai (won+lost), minimal 10 deal.
sql: SELECT r.rep_id, r.name, round(countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')), 2) AS win_rate, countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')) AS jumlah_deal_selesai FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE c.segment = 'Enterprise' GROUP BY r.rep_id, r.name HAVING jumlah_deal_selesai >= 10 AND countIf(d.stage = 'won') / countIf(d.stage IN ('won','lost')) > 0.5 ORDER BY win_rate DESC

question: Rekap mingguan 8 minggu terakhir: jumlah aktivitas per tim sales ke pelanggan SMB.
sql: SELECT toStartOfWeek(a.timestamp, 1) AS minggu, r.team, count() AS jumlah_aktivitas FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE c.segment = 'SMB' AND a.timestamp >= subtractWeeks(now(), 8) GROUP BY minggu, r.team ORDER BY minggu, r.team

question: Pelanggan wilayah APAC yang dipegang sales wilayah EMEA, sertakan nama sales dan total nilai deal mereka.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, groupUniqArray(r.name) AS daftar_sales, sum(d.value) AS total_nilai_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE c.attributes['region'] = 'APAC' AND r.region = 'EMEA' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY total_nilai_deal DESC

question: brp banyak pelanggan unik yg punya tiket urgent per tim sales (via deal pipeline)
sql: SELECT p.team, uniqExact(t.customer_id) AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT d.customer_id AS customer_id, r.team AS team FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')) AS p ON t.customer_id = p.customer_id WHERE t.priority = 'urgent' GROUP BY p.team ORDER BY jumlah_pelanggan DESC

question: Cari deal lost dari pelanggan tier Gold, tampilkan nama customer, nama sales, dan nilainya.
sql: SELECT c.name AS customer_name, r.name AS rep_name, d.value FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'lost' AND c.attributes['tier'] = 'Gold'

question: Pelanggan dengan tiket urgent terbuka tapi tidak ada aktivitas call atau meeting 14 hari terakhir, jumlahnya per tim sales (via deal pipeline).
sql: SELECT p.team, uniqExact(t.customer_id) AS jumlah_pelanggan FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT d.customer_id AS customer_id, r.team AS team FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation')) AS p ON t.customer_id = p.customer_id WHERE t.priority = 'urgent' AND t.status IN ('open','in_progress') AND t.customer_id NOT IN (SELECT a.customer_id FROM activities AS a WHERE a.type IN ('call','meeting') AND a.timestamp >= subtractDays(now(), 14)) GROUP BY p.team ORDER BY jumlah_pelanggan DESC

question: Jumlah deal won di atas 300 ribu per tim sales untuk pelanggan wilayah EMEA.
sql: SELECT r.team, count() AS jumlah_deal FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.value > 300000 AND c.attributes['region'] = 'EMEA' GROUP BY r.team ORDER BY jumlah_deal DESC

question: Rata-rata durasi call per wilayah sales ke pelanggan tier Gold
sql: SELECT r.region, round(avg(a.duration_minutes), 2) AS rata_durasi FROM activities AS a INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON a.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE a.type = 'call' AND c.attributes['tier'] = 'Gold' GROUP BY r.region ORDER BY rata_durasi DESC

question: Untuk tiap pelanggan Enterprise dengan tiket terbuka, tampilkan jumlah tiket terbuka dan nama sales yang memegang deal pipeline-nya.
sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, k.jumlah_tiket_terbuka, o.daftar_sales FROM customers AS c FINAL INNER JOIN (SELECT t.customer_id AS customer_id, count() AS jumlah_tiket_terbuka FROM support_tickets AS t FINAL WHERE t.status IN ('open','in_progress') GROUP BY t.customer_id) AS k ON c.customer_id = k.customer_id INNER JOIN (SELECT d.customer_id AS customer_id, groupUniqArray(r.name) AS daftar_sales FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage IN ('qualification','proposal','negotiation') GROUP BY d.customer_id) AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.segment = 'Enterprise' ORDER BY k.jumlah_tiket_terbuka DESC

question: Total omset per industri pelanggan untuk tiap tim sales di tahun ini.
sql: SELECT c.attributes['industry'] AS industri, r.team, sum(d.value) AS total_omset FROM deals AS d FINAL INNER JOIN customers AS c FINAL ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id INNER JOIN sales_reps AS r ON d.rep_id = r.rep_id WHERE d.stage = 'won' AND d.closed_date >= toStartOfYear(today()) GROUP BY industri, r.team ORDER BY industri, total_omset DESC
